item.title: NASA rules out March launch for manned moon mission over technical issues
item.description: Artemis 2 is a precursor to the US space agency's planned astronaut moon landing with Artemis III scheduled for 2028.

item.title: Slovakia threatens to cut electricity to Ukraine over Russian oil spat
item.description: Slovakia and Hungary vexed after Russian oil flows via Ukraine halted by alleged Russian drone strike last month.

item.title: ‘Absurd and provocative’: Huckabee faces firestorm for Israel border stance
item.description: Egypt, Jordan and Saudi Arabia denounce US ambassador's remarks suggesting Israel has right to much of the Middle East.

item.title: Venezuela receives more than 1,500 amnesty requests under new law
item.description: More than 370 political prisoners have already been granted amnesty under the US-backed legislation.

item.title: Trump’s tariff regime has been ruled unlawful. What are the implications?
item.description: The US Supreme Court has struck down President Donald Trump's central policy.

item.title: Nico O’Reilly double seals key 2-1 win for Man City over Newcastle United
item.description: Manchester City's win cut Arsenal's lead at the top of the Premier League to two points.

item.title: Pakistan carries out strikes in Afghanistan, ‘killing and wounding dozens’
item.description: Afghan Defence Ministry says the strikes hit a school and homes, killing and wounding dozens of people.

item.title: Trump to raise US global tariff to 15% after Supreme Court ruling
item.description: Move comes as businesses seek repayment for the estimated $133bn the Trump administration has already collected.

item.title: Russia-Ukraine war: List of key events, day 1,459
item.description: These are the key developments from day 1,459 of Russia’s war on Ukraine.

item.title: Eight bodies found in Libya, Greece as Mediterranean death toll rises
item.description: Bodies of five asylum seekers wash ashore in Libya as three others die in a separate incident off the coast of Greece.
